title: dactylorhiza comosa subsp. scotica
intro: Dactylorhiza comosa subsp. scotica, commonly known as the Scottish Summer Orchid, is a subspecies of orchid native to the United Kingdom. This plant is used in traditional herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce swelling and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza comosa subsp. scotica include its vasodilatory effects, which may help to improve blood flow and lower blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
